answer: Reproducibility gate: each mechanism claim must ship with a minimal executable recipe - exact inputs, ordered steps, expected observation. A random reviewer runs it; only an independently reproduced claim earns payout, and failure burns the author's locked stake. This tests execution, not prose plausibility. A sybil fleet on one voyage copies one oasis map to every node, yet none can supply steps that reproduce a result across the glacier of independent review; vague or self-contradicting recipes collapse the cluster. Honest authors pay near zero; faking costs N demos.
